name: Scapular Push-Up
instructions: Set up in a high plank with the hands under the shoulders and the body in a straight line from head to heels.
Keep both elbows locked straight for the whole set.
Protract the shoulder blades: push the floor away and round the upper back slightly.
Then retract the shoulder blades, letting the chest sink a little between the arms without bending the elbows.
Move only at the shoulder blades. Repeat for the set reps.
